title: St. Charles early acquisition before trades emerge
description: St. Charles early acquisition before trades emerge. Early cheap acquisition increases trade optionality and does not threaten liquidity. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying the cheap pink property for $140 secures a foothold in a valuable set. I have ample cash and can later develop with houses. Declining risks an auction where another player might acquire it cheaply. Purchase is the optimal long-term move.

breakdown.message: Chooses buy_property for this exact purchase/auction context.
Stays on the purchase branch when the price is strategically justified.
Leaves at least $800 after the action.
Private thought names the live strategic pressure.
